_about: The install lines each LitFamily product stub gives for one extension, as of the products' ext/a-safe-install commits. {id} is the skill id and {family} its family plugin. README.md and README_ko-KR.md show them for lit-pptx.

install: cx="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}"; p="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; for d in "$cx/skills" "$HOME/.agents/skills" "$p/.agents/skills" "$p/.codex/skills"; do [ -e "$d/{id}" ] && echo "found: $d/{id}"; done; echo "check done"

cx="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}"; if [ -e "$cx/skills/{id}" ]; then b="$cx/extension-backups/$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"; mkdir -p "$b" && [ ! -e "$b/{id}" ] && mv "$cx/skills/{id}" "$b/{id}" && echo "moved aside: $b/{id}"; fi

cx="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}"; if [ -e "$cx/skills/{id}" ]; then echo "stopped: $cx/skills/{id} still exists"; else mkdir -p "$cx/skills" && cp -R "<path to your wjgoarxiv-skills clone>/variants/litcodex/{id}" "$cx/skills/{id}"; fi

cx="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}"; [ -f "$cx/skills/{id}/SKILL.md" ] && printf '{"id":"{id}","source":"%s","variant":"litcodex","installed_at":"%s"}\n' "<path to your wjgoarxiv-skills clone>/variants/litcodex/{id}" "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" > "$cx/skills/{id}/.litfamily-extension.json"
mkdir -p ~/.config/opencode/skills && cp -R "<path to your wjgoarxiv-skills clone>/variants/litopencode/{id}" ~/.config/opencode/skills/{id}
grok plugin install "<path to your wjgoarxiv-skills clone>/variants/litgrok/{id}" --trust
update: git -C "<path to your wjgoarxiv-skills clone>" pull
grok plugin install "<path to your wjgoarxiv-skills clone>/variants/litgrok/{id}" --trust

install: muse skills install <path to your wjgoarxiv-skills clone>/variants/litmuse/{id} --scope user

if [ -e ~/.gemini/config/skills/{id} ] || [ -L ~/.gemini/config/skills/{id} ]; then b=~/.gemini/extension-backups/$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S); mkdir -p "$b" && mv ~/.gemini/config/skills/{id} "$b/" && echo "moved to $b/{id}"; fi
mkdir -p ~/.gemini/config/skills && [ ! -e ~/.gemini/config/skills/{id} ] && cp -R "<path to your wjgoarxiv-skills clone>/variants/litgravity/{id}" ~/.gemini/config/skills/{id}
install-workspace: if [ -e .agents/skills/{id} ] || [ -L .agents/skills/{id} ]; then b=~/.gemini/extension-backups/$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)-project; mkdir -p "$b" && mv .agents/skills/{id} "$b/" && echo "moved to $b/{id}"; fi
mkdir -p .agents/skills && [ ! -e .agents/skills/{id} ] && cp -R "<path to your wjgoarxiv-skills clone>/variants/litgravity/{id}" .agents/skills/{id}

install: H="${HERMES_HOME:-$HOME/.hermes}"; ID={id}; SRC="<path to your wjgoarxiv-skills clone>/variants/lithermes/{id}"
if [ -e "$H/skills/${ID:?}" ]; then mkdir -p "$H/extension-backups" && B=$(mktemp -d "$H/extension-backups/$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)-XXXX") && mv "$H/skills/$ID" "$B/" && echo "moved aside: $B/$ID"; fi
if [ -e "$H/skills/${ID:?}" ]; then echo "stopped: $H/skills/$ID is still there"; else mkdir -p "$H/skills" && cp -R "$SRC" "$H/skills/$ID" && echo "copied: $H/skills/$ID"; fi
